# Supplemental Blender Python notices

These unmodified notices were retrieved on 2026-09-08 from the source distributions of the exact Python package versions found in the official Blender 4.0.2 Linux archive. Packages were not installed or executed.

`manifest.json` records each release metadata URL, source archive URL, verified archive SHA-256, notice path inside the archive and notice SHA-256. Retrieval uses the [PyPI release JSON API](https://docs.pypi.org/api/json/). `scripts/fetch-blender-python-notices.py` reproduces acquisition and rejects changes to previously recorded archive hashes. It makes at most 18 serial requests with pacing and stops on access/rate-limit errors.

The source archives supplied 11 files for nine distributions: Cython 0.29.30, autopep8 1.6.0, certifi 2021.10.8, charset-normalizer 2.0.10, idna 3.3, pycodestyle 2.8.0, requests 2.27.1, toml 0.10.2 and urllib3 1.26.8.

These files supplement the official runtime notices; they do not replace them or establish complete corresponding-source or dependency-license coverage. They describe their respective upstream packages and retain their original terms.
